Conformance vectors of the COR ingress rule of this module, reqid.ReadCorrelation and reqid.CorrelationOf:

  correlation_of.tsv  47 rows: the Baggage header values, the X-Correlation-ID header, the COR the rule returns, the
                      member as the rule reads it, and the reason each carrier gives or refuses     (TestCorrelationVectors)

The file was authored with ECD's daemon ingress (its Step B0). It is canonical in this module from v6.10.0. A copy in
another repository is byte-identical to the file of the mx-echo version that repository pins.
